name: Harry Rogers
source:
Eternally 18 years old. Elliot’s late girlfriend who committed suicide the week after senior prom. However, by a miracle, she comes back as a boy named Harry and tries to enter a romantic relationship with Marco, the only man in his life who truly understands him for him.
